title: Genesis 22:6 — Abraham lays the wood on Isaac his son
summary: Genesis 22:6: Abraham lays the wood of the burnt offering on Isaac his son, takes the fire and the knife, and the two walk on together. Abraham is in blue (with the 'h' set apart in black), the wood in brown, and Isaac and 'son' in red.

text.text: 6 Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son, and he took in his hand the fire and the knife. So the two of them walked on together.

keywords: laid it upon Isaac his son
they went both of them together
